summary.description: Kho dữ liệu 2.254 tệp Audio Listening trên Google Drive bám sát SGK Tiếng Anh K12 và Cambridge. Dữ liệu vật lý hiện đang ở trạng thái pending download từ Google Drive archive.

tracks.title: Unit 1: Hobbies - Track 01 - Getting Started (My Favourite Hobby)
tracks.transcript: Trang: Welcome to our house, Ann! Ann: Wow, your house is so cozy! What are those models on the shelf? Trang: Those are paper flower models. I started making paper flowers two years ago. Ann: Really? Is it difficult? Trang: Not really, but you need to be patient. It helps me relax after school.

tracks.title: Unit 1: Hobbies - Track 02 - A Closer Look 1 (Pronunciation /ə/ and /ɜː/)
tracks.transcript: Listen and repeat the words. Pay attention to the sounds /ə/ and /ɜː/. Sound 1: /ə/ - away, banana, doctor, cinema. Sound 2: /ɜː/ - burn, hurt, girl, prefer, learn.

tracks.title: Unit 2: Healthy Living - Track 05 - Skills 2 (Healthy Habits for Teenagers)
tracks.transcript: Doctor Keith talks about how teenagers can maintain good health. Firstly, get at least eight hours of sleep every night. Secondly, avoid junk food with too much sugar and fat. Drink plenty of fresh water and exercise 30 minutes daily.

tracks.title: Unit 3: Community Service - Track 08 - Listening (Be a Buddy Project)
tracks.transcript: Today we interview Mai, an active member of the 'Be a Buddy' volunteer club. Mai says: 'Our club donates warm clothes, tutors street children in maths and English, and cleans up neighborhood parks every Saturday morning.'

tracks.title: Unit 4: Music and Arts - Track 11 - Getting Started (School Concert)
tracks.transcript: Duong: Nick, did you attend the spring music festival last night? Nick: Yes, I did! The traditional water puppet show was amazing. Duong: I think art exhibitions are just as exciting as rock concerts.

tracks.title: Unit 5: Food and Drink - Track 14 - Listening (Vietnamese Cuisine)
tracks.transcript: Vietnamese beef noodle soup, known worldwide as Pho, consists of flat rice noodles in a fragrant beef broth simmered for hours with cinnamon, star anise, and roasted ginger.

tracks.title: Unit 1: My New School - Track 01 - Getting Started (Special Day)
tracks.transcript: Hi Phong, are you ready for the first day of secondary school? Yes, Vy! I have my new school bag, calculator, and uniform ready.

tracks.title: Unit 1: Leisure Time - Track 03 - Listening (Origami and DIY Crafts)
tracks.transcript: In this modern digital age, many teens find solace in hands-on hobbies like origami folding and DIY room decor, keeping their eyes away from smartphone screens.

tracks.title: Unit 2: City Life - Track 06 - Listening (Urban Advantages and Challenges)
tracks.transcript: While metropolitan cities offer premier educational institutions and bustling recreational amenities, high cost of living and traffic congestion remain pressing dilemmas.

tracks.title: Unit 3: Music - Track 09 - Listening (The Evolution of Traditional Music)
tracks.transcript: Quan Ho singing and Ca Tru represent the pinnacle of northern Vietnamese lyrical folk poetry, recognized internationally as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

tracks.title: Unit 5: Global Warming - Track 12 - Listening (Renewable Solutions)
tracks.transcript: Atmospheric greenhouse gases have reached historic peaks. Mitigating carbon emissions requires rapid deployment of offshore wind farms, solar grids, and battery storage.

tracks.title: Unit 1: Life Stories - Track 15 - Listening (Biography of Historical Figures)
tracks.transcript: Examining General Vo Nguyen Giap's tactical brilliance during the Dien Bien Phu campaign demonstrates how strategic patience and logistical mobilization overcome superior armaments.

tracks.title: Cambridge A2 Key (KET) - Practice Test 1 - Listening Part 1
tracks.transcript: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short conversations. You will hear each conversation twice. Question 1: What time does the train to Oxford leave? Conversation: Excuse me, does the train leave at quarter past ten? No, it leaves at twenty to eleven.

tracks.title: Cambridge B1 Preliminary (PET) - Practice Test 1 - Listening Part 2
tracks.transcript: You will hear an interview with a young wildlife photographer called Sarah. Sarah, how did you get started in nature photography? Well, my father gave me an old manual SLR camera when I was twelve, and we spent weekends tracking red deer in the Scottish highlands.

tracks.title: IELTS Academic Listening - Section 1: University Accommodation Registration
tracks.transcript: Good morning, University Housing Office. How can I help you today? Hello, I'm an incoming postgraduate international student, and I'd like to inquire about on-campus hall residence options for the autumn trimester.
